title: Airy Light Japanese Fish Sushi
description: A cultured and dense Japanese dish featuring salsa and shio-cure, wrapped in a ti-leaf for a low-fat and refreshing meal. This dish is perfect for those looking for a light and healthy sushi option.
instructions: Prepare the sushi rice according to the package instructions using 1 cup of water.
In a small saucepan, combine the rice vinegar, sugar, and salt, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer the vinegar mixture for 5 minutes.
Allow the sushi rice to cool, then mix in the vinegar mixture.
Cut the sushi-grade fish into small pieces and cure with the shio-cure mixture for 30 minutes.
Rinse the fish pieces and pat dry with paper towels.
Lay a ti-leaf flat and spread a thin layer of sushi rice onto the center of the leaf.
Place a few pieces of the cured fish on top of the rice, followed by a spoonful of salsa.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and scallions over the top of the fish.
Fold the ti-leaf over the filling to form a tight package, and serve immediately.
